entities.name: Peresopnytsia Gospel
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Peresopnytsia Gospel is a 16th-century illuminated manuscript Gospel book written in the Ruthenian language. It is now in the Vernadsky National Library of Ukraine. Since 1991, all Ukrainian presidents have taken the oath of office on these gospels.
